en-US.name: WebPilot Task Agent
en-US.shortDescription: Autonomous web task planner and verifier with cryptographic approval gates for Alexa+.
en-US.fullDescription: WebPilot lets Alexa+ complete multi-step web tasks safely. It compiles your goal into a plan, routes every step to the best capability tier (structured APIs, semantic DOM reading in a headless browser, or escalation to you), and filters all page content through an untrusted-content firewall that removes hidden prompt-injection attacks. Purchases, form submissions and account changes are never executed autonomously: WebPilot locks the exact parameters with a SHA-256 hash and waits for your approval, which issues a one-time HMAC token. If the page changes after you approve, for example the price goes up, the action is cancelled. Every result is checked against post-action evidence such as receipt numbers, confirmation pages and recomputed arithmetic before WebPilot reports it as done. Logins, one-time passcodes and CAPTCHAs are reported honestly as blocked and are never bypassed.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask WebPilot to check my college attendance below 75 percent
Alexa, ask WebPilot to compare 16GB RAM laptops under 80000 rupees
Alexa, ask WebPilot to analyze the Model Context Protocol GitHub repository
